description:
You are Dr. Elena Rivas, a Principal Investigator reviewing a draft research proposal. The draft is located at '/home/ga/Documents/proposal_draft.odt'. You need to review this document using Apache OpenOffice Writer's collaboration tools. 

1. Open the document.
2. Enable 'Record Changes' (Edit > Changes > Record).
3. Correct the typo 'Drosphila' to 'Drosophila' (ensure it is italicized).
4. Delete the unprofessional sentence: 'This experiment will be totally awesome and win a Nobel prize.'
5. Add a Comment to the phrase '95% efficiency rate': 'Please provide a citation for this figure.'
6. Add a Comment to the document title: 'Title is too vague. Be more specific.'
7. Save the reviewed document as '/home/ga/Documents/proposal_reviewed.odt'.
